package.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
package.description: The Cardiac Output Module adds functionality to LabChart to calculate cardiac output from a recorded thermodilution curve.

en-US.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
en-US.description: The Cardiac Output Module adds functionality to LabChart to calculate cardiac output from a recorded thermodilution curve.
en-US.longDescription: The Cardiac Output Module adds functionality to LabChart to calculate cardiac output from a recorded thermodilution curve. The cardiac output calculation is based on the area under the thermodilution curve, and takes account of prolongation of the decay curve due to recirculation of the injectate.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Cardiac Output

zh-CN.description: Cardiac Output 模块为 LabChart 增加了从记录的热稀释曲线计算心输出量的功能。
zh-CN.longDescription: Cardiac Output 模块为 LabChart 增加了从记录的热稀释曲线计算心输出量的功能。该心输出量计算基于热稀释曲线下面积，并考虑了注射剂再循环导致的衰减曲线延长效应。

package.longDescription: The Cardiac Output Module adds functionality to LabChart to calculate cardiac output from a recorded thermodilution curve. The cardiac output calculation is based on the area under the thermodilution curve, and takes account of prolongation of the decay curve due to recirculation of the injectate.
package.name: ADInstruments Cardiac Output
